scope: Theorem 1.2 (Powers of diagonal complete intersections) of the manuscript “Abelian covers, Gale correspondences, and the Hodge conjecture for powers” (preprints/Abelian-covers-Gale-correspondences-and-the-Hodge-conjecture-for-powers-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 032 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3467c8077855a568), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix n ≥ 2, d ≥ 0, c ∈ {0, 1, 2}, and put m = d + c + 1. Outside a countable union of proper closed algebraic subsets of Dc,m, the rational Hodge conjecture holds in every codimension on Xu A for every u ≥ 1. For c ≤ 1, or for d = 0, no exceptional subset is needed.
